notes: Help coverage proves parser and dispatch discoverability, not live semantics for every mutating path.
The SHA-256 binds this result to the exact checked-in command manifest; every one of its 136 paths was invoked with --help and all 108 handler references resolved.

Mutating validation was limited to the explicitly scoped single-user lifecycle and benchmark workflows; destructive host reset, promotion, and broad cache-prune applies were guard/dry-run and contract tested rather than executed.
Voice audio benchmark passed through the explicit Dark-owned audio scope; it does not claim Mini-owned realtime proxy coverage.
